filesystem_tests: Actual private files, directory walking, symlink refusal, flock, no-replace links, integrity checks, interruption cleanup and inode-preserving repeat.
input_format: Header-free concatenation in the fixed NAMES order; exact per-bundle byte counts and digests plus whole-stream byte count and digest; EOF required.
limits: This receiver verifies opaque bytes; Git autonomy and exact references are verified by the separate governance importer.
Local filesystem qualification substitutes owner IDs; it does not claim a root VM or production execution.

SIGKILL or power loss can leave a root-private staging directory. A kill between link and unlink can leave a two-link final inode; subsequent receipt refuses it until a separately reviewed cleanup. No unverified final file or overwrite is authorized.
proved: All nine segments and overall digest/EOF verified before any new final file.
Corrupt, truncated, oversized, wrong-digest and late-invalid streams accept no new final files.
Different contents, wrong owner/group/modes, symlinks, hardlinks, FIFOs and directories refuse before input.
Concurrent lock and insufficient disk reserve refuse before input.
Foreign destination appearing during receive or immediately at installation is never replaced.
SIGTERM handler during receive cleans staged files; retry after failure between final installations succeeds.
Repeated successful input preserves pre-existing final bytes and inode metadata.
Unsealed template and extra argv refuse with a fixed JSON result, without exception or input output.
synthetic_substitutions: OWNER uses the invoking local uid/gid for filesystem tests; production root refusal is checked separately.
Complete deliver test substitutes DIRECTORY and PREVIOUS only, in addition to fixture OWNER; function implementations unchanged.
